messages:
maya: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/regs-heatmap — proposing row-grouping in the regression heatmap so related prompt variants stack together. thinking this will help reviewers scan diffs across a prompt set instead of hunting by test id. what do you all think? eli: love the idea. currently rows are flat which makes context loss when teams ship lots of small variants. grouping by prompt-set then variant -> makes A/B comparisons easier. :+1: aisha: a11y nit: if we group rows we need to ensure group headers are keyboard-focusable and announced. Screen readers should get something like "Group: Checkout flow, 4 items, collapsed" when collapsed. sam: Copy nit for approval flow: when grouped, the bulk approve CTA should say `Approve visible` or `Approve group` depending on selection. right now `Approve` feels ambiguous. also suggest: `Approve selected changes (3)` pattern. devon: layout thought — if we stack groups, we should keep the row density toggle but default to slightly taller rows when grouping to avoid truncation of labels. Compact mode can collapse metadata. maya: accessibility suggestion from a11y review: use `role=group` on the header + `aria-expanded` and provide an `aria-controls` target. quick example: ```
Group: Checkout flow (4)
    ... rows ...
``` aisha: small tweak: add `aria-label` on the expand button like `Expand checkout flow tests` and ensure the expand target gets focus when opened. keyboard users should land at the first diff row. eli: UX question: should grouping be on by default for prompt-set views and off for flat test-run views? my vote: on by default in Prompt Sets page, off in Run Results to match existing expectations. sam: also a copy microcopy suggestion for the heatmap legend: change `Regressions` to `Regression diffs` — clearer for new users. devon: performance note — grouping will require virtualized anchors per group. we should add tests for scroll anchoring when groups collapse/expand. pinging eng-runtime for perf estimate. maya: thanks. i'll prototype two variants in figma (grouped default + grouped optional) and add a short accessibility checklist. Will file tickets: UI-4234 (grouping experiment), A11Y-187 (screen reader ARIA updates), PERF-998 (scroll anchoring tests). product-bot: create the tickets? product-bot: Created UI ticket UI-4234 and A11Y ticket A11Y-187. Assigned to maya and aisha. :white_check_mark: aisha: one more microcopy thing — for the group header CTA use `Review group` rather than `Open` to make action intent clearer (we expect people to inspect diffs). eli: agree with `Review group`. also add an inline `Show all failures` CTA for groups with >10 failures to expand filtered view. maya: great. next steps: i'll drop two prototype frames by EOD, include keyboard walkthrough, and link the tickets in the thread. thanks all. :pray:
